Metadata.Title: God of War III Remastered
Metadata.Name: Bug Fix - Texture Corruption Fix
Metadata.Note: Fixes corrupted textures in the game by increasing the Video Arena size, allowing the game to use more video memory for textures and effects. Requires setting DMEM to 2048 MB or more, or the game crashes. Enable either this patch or one resolution patch, never both.
Metadata.Author: cuesta4

Metadata.Title: God of War III Remastered
Metadata.Name: Resolution Patch - 480p
Metadata.Note: Decreases game output resolution to 854x480 and increases Video Arena to 2.25 GiB. Requires setting DMEM to 2048 MB or more. Only leave one resolution patch enabled; do not enable it with Bug Fix - Texture Corruption Fix.
Metadata.Author: kvicken + cuesta4

Metadata.Title: God of War III Remastered
Metadata.Name: Resolution Patch - 720p
Metadata.Note: Decreases game output resolution to 1280x720 and increases Video Arena to 2.25 GiB. Requires setting DMEM to 2048 MB or more. Only leave one resolution patch enabled; do not enable it with Bug Fix - Texture Corruption Fix.
Metadata.Author: kvicken + cuesta4

Metadata.Title: God of War III Remastered
Metadata.Name: Resolution Patch - 1440p
Metadata.Note: Increases game output resolution to 2560x1440 and Video Arena to 2.75 GiB. Requires setting DMEM to 3072 MB or more. Only leave one resolution patch enabled; do not enable it with Bug Fix - Texture Corruption Fix.
Metadata.Author: kvicken + cuesta4

Metadata.Title: God of War III Remastered
Metadata.Name: Resolution Patch - 1800p

Metadata.Author: kvicken + cuesta4

Metadata.Title: God of War III Remastered
Metadata.Name: Resolution Patch - 4K
Metadata.Note: Increases game output resolution to 3840x2160 and Video Arena to approximately 4 GB (3.75 GiB). Requires setting DMEM to 6144 MB or more. Only leave one resolution patch enabled; do not enable it with Bug Fix - Texture Corruption Fix.
Metadata.Author: kvicken + cuesta4

Metadata.Title: God of War III Remastered
Metadata.Name: Frame Rate Patch - 120 FPS
Metadata.Note: Raises the engine maximum framerate from 59.94 to 120 FPS so the frametime clamp produces a 1/120 second gameplay delta. Corrects swing energy calculations to match the original 60 Hz simulation. Requires setting VBlank to 120 FPS.
Metadata.Author: kvicken

Metadata.Title: God of War III Remastered
Metadata.Name: Skip Intro
Metadata.Note: Skips the initial logos. Thanks to illusion0001 aka illusionyy for the PS3 patch which made this very easy.
Metadata.Author: cuesta4

Metadata.Title: God of War III Remastered
Metadata.Name: Skip Any Video With X Button
Metadata.Note: Allows manual skipping of cinematics any cinematic with the X button. Thanks to illusion0001 aka illusionyy for the PS3 patch which made this very easy.
Metadata.Author: cuesta4
